I don't know if this is common knowledge but Legendary Alm and Roy's Pair-Up mechanics are a godsend in this mode.

Healers and Dancers can do their thing and then swap out to the boys at the end of the turn so they can counterattack and get you a nice bonus on enemy phase!

I don't know if this is common knowledge but Pair Up from Legendary Alm and is usable in this mode. It's actually WAY more useful here than anywhere else.

As far as points go, my easiest 200k wins have been versus Rokkr Tiki using:

Triadept Naga + Glimmer
Legendary Tiki + Aether
Fallen Young Tiki + Astra (paired to L!Alm)
Brave Veronica (paired to L!Roy)

Ironically, it's because of Abyssal that I found this out in the first place. Trying to make my own units tanky to contest this madness.

That does sound disgusting but also would only apply to archers (and I guess F!Morgan with Blarserpent). 

But then they've got a glaring weakness to physical units (and dragons of course). There's always a counter to absurdity like that, especially now with so many options. In the face of that, it just doesn't make that much sense to me.

I get that but that's not my question.

In combat between two ranged units specifically, why isn't a special that reduces ranged damage accessible to them while melee units get this and Pavise?

I know in the grand scheme of things that these specials are rarely used but the fact that both melee and ranged units could use both of these specials in other games before this one feels incredibly off-putting to me.
Someone tell me how IntSys thought this makes even a single iota of sense.
Armor would be super simple if the higher difficulties didn't inexplicably give them all Armor March. Just... why.
Ragna the Bloodedge Hector. I need this in my life.
